notes: These are research TOPICS not 18th-century Atlas events or published facts.
Research windows identify investigative scope; do NOT assert each year has an event.
Groups are editorial facets and not moral/scientific rankings.
Evidence supported_scope means one or more documented anchor facts exist; no automatic approval of full multi-year harm, boundary, casualty or tax total.
Every topic must receive actor-specific claim-to-source evidence, competing local agency, year-by-year state review, and GIS QA before publication.
No source with archive_catalogue_only may be described as personally reading the historical manuscript.
